description: React component for displaying and managing installed outgoing webhooks in Mattermost, including filtering, editing, regenerating tokens, and deleting webhooks.

classes.name: InstalledOutgoingWebhook
classes.description: React component class for rendering an outgoing webhook item with management options.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Function to determine if an outgoing webhook matches a given filter string based on display name, description, trigger words, or channel name.

methods.name: handleRegenToken
methods.description: Event handler to trigger token regeneration for the webhook.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Event handler to delete the webhook.

methods.name: makeDisplayName
methods.description: Generates display name for the webhook, defaulting to 'A Private Webhook' if none is set.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the webhook details, including filtering, display name, description, trigger words, URLs, trigger conditions, token, creator info, and management actions.
